items.topic: Reviewer sessions use proxy opus model
items.fact: Both blueprint reviewer sessions (Mate, Gabor) must be spawned with model proxy/cc/claude-opus-5-5. The 'proxy' provider (https://llmproxy.cluster1.judo.technology/v1, api openai-responses) in ~/.pi/agent/providers.json has an empty models list, so any model id passes through; the container gets only the proxy key, never Anthropic/Google keys.
items.evidence: session 2026-11-06T11:02:34, operator: 'for both sesions use proxy cc opus 5-5'

items.topic: Blueprint-review skill lives only in the docker, not the repo
items.fact: The blueprint-review skill (.pi/skills/blueprint-review/SKILL.md + initial-prompt.md) must be baked only into the review docker image; delete it from the repo after finishing. Operator also wants the docker built.
items.evidence: session 2026-11-06T11:09:35, operator: 'Delete this skill after fisnihing! only add it to the docker! build the docker!'

items.claim: Agent wrote the skill into the repo's .pi/skills.
items.fact: Operator corrected: skill must exist only in the container; remove repo copy at the end.

items.topic: Review state data model for blueprint review
items.fact: Review app (target/review-app/server.py) parses knowledge-gaps-report.md and catalog-update-report.md (openspec/changes/restructure-blueprints-for-kb) into topics split on ## / ### headings, ids '<doc>:<slug>:<hash>' (slug = lowercase non-alnum→'-' max 60; hash = sha1[:10]), decisions accept|needs-change|defer|reject plus notes in review-state.json, deep link <review-url>/#<id>. Each reviewer writes only suggestions-<name>.md for later merge. Gaps report: 324 validated gaps in 72 topics from 420 candidates (16 already covered, 79 not needed, 1 unverifiable), checked against 565 catalog files.

items.topic: Gaps: testing knowledge missing in catalog
items.fact: Missing: testkit caching (BY_CLASS, shareInjector), choosing the test DB (PostgreSQL/Yugabyte containers), API-level tests, multi-JVM heap failures that silently skip classes, E2E baseline-dump method. Also missing platform runtime behaviour: signed identifiers, S3/GCS filestore settings, CORS, local mail testing; and 7 rackinspect domains without blueprint (inspection fault registry/ticketing, offer pricing, job sheet→work report→certificate, partner-scoped multi-role users).

Dashboard never ships Keycloak. E2E uses a fake OIDC issuer (packages/shared/src/test-support/fake-oidc-issuer.ts) enabled by PI_E2E_IDENTITY=1 in docker/test-entrypoint.sh (compose.test.identity.yml); PI_E2E_IDENTITY_LOGIN=1 adds login form; PI_E2E_IDENTITY_KEYCLOAK uses a real realm. Realm reference docker/fixtures/keycloak/realm-identity-plane.json (realm pi-identity, PKCE client dashboard-web, audience pi-dashboard, users anna/bela with password <user>-pw). Login UI plugin: spike/identity-login-plane (env PI_LOGIN_ISSUER/PI_LOGIN_CLIENT_ID). Issuer is http on loopback so keycloak-resolver needs allowInsecureHttp; resolver + login plugin must be in identity.trustedResolverPlugins in config.json.

items.topic: Build pi-dashboard docker image from source
items.fact: Build: cd pi-agent-dashboard && docker build -f docker/Dockerfile -t pi-dashboard:blueprint . (node:26-bookworm-slim, pnpm monorepo, ~143MB context, ~7 min, 1.18GB image; runtime npmGlobal 0.11.0). Container HOME=/home/pi; config /home/pi/.pi/dashboard/config.json; plugins /home/pi/.pi/dashboard/plugins/; providers /home/pi/.pi/agent/providers.json; entrypoint env DASHBOARD_PORT, PI_GATEWAY_PORT, TUNNEL_ENABLED=0. Derive a thin image FROM it to COPY config/plugins/credentials. Vite build prints a warning that minimatch 'default' is not exported (enabled-models-match.ts:20) but build succeeds.

items.topic: Keycloak 26 start-dev with realm import; issuer must match host
items.fact: quay.io/keycloak/keycloak:26.0 with 'start-dev --import-realm', bootstrap admin via KC_BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_USERNAME/PASSWORD. Discovery ready ~8s. Direct-grant (password) token: POST /realms/pi-identity/protocol/openid-connect/token with grant_type=password client_id=dashboard-web scope=openid works; aud=pi-dashboard. The token iss follows the Host header, so the in-container resolver and host browser must both use the same URL (http://localhost:18080) — solved by a wrapper forwarding container 127.0.0.1:18080 -> keycloak:8080. The keycloak image has no shell tools for a healthcheck (no /dev/tcp reliable); wait for discovery in the wrapper instead.

Once enforced, GET /api/identity/login-config returns active provider (identity-login-plane, loginUrl /identity-login/start); GET /api/identity/me with Bearer returns {enforced:true, principal:{iss,sub,email}, can:{...}}; GET /api/sessions with bearer returns only that user's sessions. Loopback inside the container is NOT treated as operator once identity is enforced ('sign_in_required').

items.topic: Spawned reviewer sessions invisible to their owners
items.claim: POST spawn with reviewer bearer should stamp reviewer as session owner
items.fact: Spawn returned 200 ('Pi session started via RPC keeper') for gabor and mate, but afterwards each reviewer saw 0 sessions while the operator view showed 2; session dirs under /home/pi/.pi/agent/sessions/--work-gabor-- were empty and there is a spawn-failures.log. Suspected: sessions spawned ownerless via keeper path, or spawn failed. Unresolved in this chunk. Expected: session owned by the bearer principal and visible to them.

Environment hooks: after repeated source searching without kb_search, a '[kb] ... run kb_search' guard message is injected; raw curl in bash triggers 'use context-mode tools' hint — use 'curl -s -o file' and read file. Bash output over ~4KB is truncated; list_models output is huge (~80KB).

items.topic: Idempotency check pitfall in spawn script
items.fact: Spawn script's existing-session check parsed /api/sessions wrong: response is {success:true,data:[...]} (data is a list), not data.sessions; parse yielded 'undefined'.
